paite: Huan TOUPA min a athilhih tungtang thu a Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpinu'n ana zak in thuhaksa pipi toh amah ettel tum in akiang ah ahoh hi.
heading: Sheba Kumpinu Hong Vehna / (2 Kro 9.1-12)
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

paite: Jerusalem ah nungzui mi tampi toh, gimlimte leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua sangawngsaute tonpih in ahoh hi. Solomon kiang atun in alungtang a thu a pai tengteng suahkhe vek in ahoupih hi.
english: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

paite: Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a; kumpipa theih louh, ahilhchet theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

paite: Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pildan tengteng, a-inn lam,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

paite: adohkan a nek ding, asikhate tutdan, anasemte nasepdan, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite, TOUPA' inn a lat halmang thillatte amuh in lungsim chih leng nei zou lou khop in lamdang asa hi.
english: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildante ka gam a ka zak thuthang adik mah ana hi.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

paite: Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen uh ka taksang kei hi. Huchi in ngai in, akimkhat leng ahon na hilh sam ua, agen uh ka zak sang in na pildan leh na hoihdan ana thupizaw hi.
english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

paite: Na mite, hiai na sikha, na kiang a om gige na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete ahampha uhi!
english: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak mahmah, Israelte laltutphah a hon tusakpa phat in om hen. TOUPA'N Israelte tangtawn in a-it a, huaiziak in, diktattak a vaihawm ding in kumpipa in ahon bawl hi," achi hi.
english: Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim atam a tam leh suangmantamte kumpipa apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang lawmlawm a tam alut ngei kei hi.
english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

paite: Hiram longhon, Ophir a pan dangka-eng va pote'n leng Ophir a pan almug sing tampi leh suangmantamte ahon pua uhi.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

paite: Kumpipa'n almug singte TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding in leh lasa mite kaihging leh pekging bawlna ding in azang hi. Tuni tan in hichibang almug sing himhim alut in, muh leng muh ahi nawnta kei hi.
english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

paite: Anget louh Solomon in apiakte chih louh leng kumpipa Solomon in Sheba kumpinu'n adeih tengteng, anget peuhmah apia hi. Huchi in amah leh lawite a-omna gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

paite: Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Hauhsakna / (2 Kro 9.13-29)
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

paite: Hiaite lou leng sumsin mite leh thilzuak mite, Arab kumpipate leh gamsung vaihawmte a pan siahpiakte anei lai hi.
english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekpek in lum lian zanih abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk alut hi.
english: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

paite: Dangka-eng sekpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng mina thum alut a; huaite kumpipa'n Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

paite: Kumpipa'n saiha laltutphah thupi mahmah abawl a, huai dangka-eng hoihpen tui in aluan hi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

paite: Laltutphah kaltouhna ah siksan guk a-om a, laltutphah nunglam dawn abem hi. Atutna sik tuak ah douna a-om tuaktuak a; adouna zulte ah humpinelkai dingh lim nih a-om hi.
english: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

paite: Siksan gukte sik tuak ah humpinelkai dingh sawm-le-nih lim a-om a; huchibang koi gam mah ah leng abawl ngei kei uhi.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa nou tengteng dangka-eng ahi vek a, Lebanon gammang inn a, atui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng ngen mah ahi vek uhi. Dangka himhim a-om kei. Solomon dam lai in huai bangpi in asim kei uh.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa'n tuipi ah Hiram longhon kithuahpih Tarshish longhon anei a; Tarshish longhon in kum thum hal zel in dangka-eng, dangka, saiha, zawng leh utong ahon po zel uhi.
english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung a kumpipa tengteng hauh lam leh pil lam in akhup vek hi.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

paite: Pathian in alungtang a pilna thu akoihsak ngaikhe ding in leitung a mi tengteng in Solomon ahong zuan huthut zel uhi.
english: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

paite: Michih in thilpiakte kum teng a piak zah nei in dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puan, galvan, gimlim, sakol leh sabiltungnoute ahong pe zel uhi.
english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

paite: Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a, kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi. Huaite kangtalai koihnate ah, Jerusalem a kumpipa omna ah a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah atam mahmah ziak in dangka chite suang bang mai a sehkhop in a-omsak a, sidar singte phai a theipi sing bang lel a sehkhop in a-omsak hi.
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon neih sakolte Aigupta gam a pan ahon tolhkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in ana khak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

paite: Aigupta gam a kangtalai dangka chi shekel zaguk zel in leh sakol dangka chi shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in ahon polut uhi. Huchibang mah in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate a ding in leng apokhia uhi.
english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.
